source: Zhang et al. (2024), results of RQ1.xlsx
snippet: whole function fmt_cli_resp, lines 105 to 216 of the original
external_dependencies: termcolor==3.3.0 (installed for real, pinned in requirements.txt)
removed_from_original: get_weather_data, get_city_name, format_weather_link and the imports of requests, .decoder and .errors: not used by the snippet.
scaffolding: run(data, city, country_code): calls fmt_cli_resp with start_time = datetime.now(), so that the entry point has 3 parameters and the elapsed time comes out close to zero.

side_effects.description: The snippet only prints. The color depends on the environment (FORCE_COLOR, NO_COLOR, terminal), and termcolor caches that decision.
side_effects.handling: The fixture of the test fixes the environment and clears the cache of termcolor.can_colorize.

pinned_behavior: typical: with color forced, all the exact lines, with the termcolor codes; today's date is computed by the test with the same format.
edge: without color, an empty dictionary with 6 empty forecasts: everything becomes N/A and index 0 of the forecast is never printed.
invalid: with 3 forecasts, prints days 1 and 2 and raises IndexError on the third.
Defect of the original, pinned as it is: the wind loses its first character ([1:]), so 'N 10 km/h' comes out as ' 10 km/h'.
not_pinned_on_purpose: Value of the elapsed time in the footer: only the format (number with decimal places).

adaptation_check.snippet_diff: identical to the original (lines 105 to 216 against 16 to 127 of the unit)
adaptation_check.pysmell: LM detected, MLOC=76, same as the original; nothing in the scaffolding
